doc.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Recording with Fraser MacPherson, Jay McShann and Jake Hanna
summary: After a playback, Galloway describes Fraser MacPherson and their CDs, and Jake Hanna's friendship with McShann.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well let’s listen — I just wanted to listen to a little piece of one of your recordings.
Now you managed to get Jay McShann and Jake Hanna on this record. I’m not as familiar with Fraser MacPherson.

Fraser MacPherson is a marvelous tenor saxophone player who is from Vancouver. And he and I made a couple of CDs together, one with the big band and another one being a concert in Switzerland. We’d known each other for many years and unfortunately his last two recordings were the ones he did with me, and he passed on. And Jake there, Jake and Jay are buddies.
